text:
incidents-bot: [ALERT] 2718281828 - Multiple GPU OOMs observed in production inference-serving during prefill (long-context). Several pods in inference-pool-2 restarted (approx 12%). Trigger: OOM SIGKILL on nvidia-driver.

oncall-alex: paging @sre-lee @eng-runtime-maya @eng-ml-rene - I'm on it, will coordinate triage. Allocated pager slot.

sre-lee: oncall here. First step: collecting pod logs + oom-kernel messages. Run:
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l pool=inference-pool-2
kubectl -n inference logs pod/<podname> --previous
journalctl -k | grep -i oom
```
I see repeated "Out of memory: Killed process" entries in kernel logs.

eng-runtime-maya: likely prefill growth with very long prompts + kvcache bloat. Quick mitigations: 1) disable prefetch/prefill for requests > 4096 tokens, 2) reduce batch_size to 1 for affected pool, 3) route large-context requests to smaller quantized variant. Creating config patch now.

eng-ml-rene: adding model-side guard: enforce max_input_tokens=8192 at router layer to avoid runaway prefill. Also recommend enabling kvcache-eviction=on with threshold 0.8.

cust-ops-jordan: customer impact: monitoring shows spikes in 5xx for a subset of API keys (two mid-enterprise customers). We should prepare an initial customer note.

support-sam: prepping customer update: "We're investigating increased 500 responses for long-context requests; temporary mitigation applied; follow-up ETA ~30-60m." Sending now.

infra-eli: spun up 4 additional GPU nodes and patching autoscaler to allow burst. node drain started for 3 flaky nodes.

eng-runtime-maya: hotfix deployed: PATCH /configs/pools/inference-pool-2
- set PREFILL_PREFETCH=false
- PREFILL_TOKEN_LIMIT=8192
- BATCH_SIZE=1
Applied to 10% canary first.

sre-lee: canary looks stable for 8 minutes, no restarts. Scaling canary to 50%.

incidents-bot: PagerDuty note: oncall-alex acknowledged at 2718281875

oncall-alex: rolling 100% rollout now. Keeping autoscaler to burst-up for 20m.

eng-ml-rene: also toggled kvcache-eviction at 0.75 and enabled early-trim for prefix tokens for requests > 4096.

cust-ops-jordan: initial customer messages sent. Logging inbound support tickets; I'll coordinate follow-ups.

sre-lee: nodes replaced; pod restart rate back to baseline. CPU fallback paths triggered for a small fraction (~0.6%) while routing stabilized.

eng-runtime-maya: follow-up: added telemetry to track prefill token distribution and per-request kvcache size. We'll run an eval to detect failing prompts.

support-sam: updating status page: "Partial degradation resolved; customers experiencing errors should see recovery. Root cause: GPU OOMs during prefill for very large input windows. Working on long-term fix."

oncall-alex: handing off to eng-runtime-maya for postmortem and next steps. Thanks all.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT: resolved 2718282460 - severity reduced to degraded, monitoring."
